        "All five owned diffs read. New headers enter mRequireFiltering once at synchronization, after new-message status updates. PerformFiltering asks whether incoming filters need a full body, drops missing headers, leaves non-Offline messages pending when body is required, and removes ready keys while assembling targetMsgs. Copied-in messages do not enter this new-header set. The original set is folder state, not a persistent filtering journal.",
        "Targets are removed before ApplyFilters starts, not after verified successful filtering despite the broader header comment wording. Immediate ApplyFilters failure returns without restoring removed keys; notification wrappers ignore PerformFiltering result. The completion lambda does not inspect its status before FiltersApplied notification and junk classification. Therefore queue removal, event notification and a successful filter outcome are separate contracts. No filter failure or lost-work scenario was reproduced.",

Foreground channel does so only on fetch success before local-store read; AutoSync callback does so before manager completion even on its failed fetch status, and the actual filtering predicate checks Offline flags. Original keys parameter is unused; review debates future interface shape, while the later separate3720 removes it. Do not claim removal was adopted in this own landing.",

It retains readiness selection and removal-before-dispatch, with later targetHeaders/native listener setup. Current header-only immediate path caches headers, while body-needed entries wait. Those later header-block/API details are comparison, not this landing credit.",

No full-body filter, fetch, folder move, semaphore, storage, classification, build/lint/test or UI/a11y run. Selected native filter-service implementation and deeper error recovery remain bounded dependencies.",

Public comment saying removed when filtered overstates this dispatch boundary; precise future comments should distinguish selection from completion. Copy-avoidance/error/progress design and tests are deferred. No Done marker substitutes for source adoption or new filter execution."
